hook.text: Every cloud publishes a reference architecture for data platforms. They look different but follow the same pattern.

buildup.text: The pattern: ingest into object storage, transform with compute, serve from a warehouse, orchestrate with DAGs.

discovery.text: Add a catalog for discovery, a governance layer for security, and monitoring for observability.

twist.text: Reference architectures are starting points, not blueprints. Every real platform deviates based on specific needs.

climax.text: Understanding the pattern lets you evaluate any cloud's offering by mapping their services to standard layers.

punchline.text: Same pattern. Different services. Every cloud.

quiz.question: What is the standard pattern across cloud data platform architectures?
options: Ingest, transform, serve, and orchestrate with governance and monitoring
